issues.legal_issue: A person claiming to be a tenant may invoke the statutory protection against eviction for rent default without an admitted landlord-tenant relationship.
material_facts: An eviction action was brought on several grounds, including non-payment of rent.
On the first hearing date, rent arrears, interest and costs were tendered on behalf of the respondents, including a person alleged by the landlord to be an unauthorised subtenant.
The landlord rejected the tender because it included payment on behalf of that disputed claimant.
The lower courts treated the tender as invalid because the claimant was not an undisputed tenant.
issues.conclusion: The protection against eviction for rent default may be invoked by a tenant or by a person claiming to be a tenant; an admitted landlord-tenant relationship is not required. The appeal was allowed, the lower-court judgment was reversed, and the matter was remitted for disposal in accordance with this ruling.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 2(h)(i) and 13(2)(i), the defined meaning of a word ordinarily governs unless the subject or context requires otherwise. Context includes the provision’s place within the Act, ordinary and technical usage, and the provision’s purpose and place in the wider legal scheme. The proviso to section 13(2)(i) is intended to protect against eviction for rent default when the arrears, interest and costs are tendered at the first hearing, and should be construed meaningfully rather than narrowly. The Court relied on Vanguard Fire and General Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Fraser and Ross, Mangat Rai v. Kidarnath, and the interpretive discussion in Cross’s Statutory Interpretation; it overruled Ram Gopal v. Ram Prakash and Punjab Rajasthan Goods Carriers v. Onkar Mal.

predicates.eviction_sought_for_rent_default: A landlord brings an eviction proceeding relying on the occupant’s failure to pay rent.
predicates.claimant_tenders_arrears_on_first_hearin: A person claiming to be a tenant tenders the rent arrears at the first hearing of the eviction proceeding.
predicates.claimant_tenders_interest_and_costs: That claimant also tenders the interest and costs required for the rent-default protection.
predicates.tenancy_claimant_may_avail_default_cure_: A person claiming to be a tenant may invoke the protection against eviction for rent default without an admitted landlord-tenant relationship.

issues.definition: When eviction is sought for rent default and a tenancy claimant tenders the arrears, interest and costs at the first hearing, that claimant may invoke the protection against eviction for the default.
